purpose: Make Character Design Sheet 01-04 composition a strict child of the current Character Reference Production Entrypoint so wrapper changes on main are inherited live instead of requiring a stale parent script name in this bridge.

observedLatestMain.note: This SHA records the synchronization baseline, not a permanent authority freeze. A newer main must be rechecked before generation or merge.

existingInventoryPacket.reason: Static packets can become stale whenever main adds production authority. The live Sheet Adapter resolves the current top-level Character Reference Production Entrypoint on every export.

hold.reason: User explicitly put Yui production aside after Sheet 01 attempt 01 rejection. Keep all rejected history/lineage, but do not regenerate Yui or advance Sheet 02-04 while this hold remains active.

latestInheritedAuthorities.rule: Solve overlap by camera/crop, authorized placement, physical deformation, omission of hidden micro-detail or Human review; never redesign construction to remove collisions.
Adapt composition before sacrificing identity-bearing silhouette, species, prop, mobility, ground-contact or construction information.
Focus, depth of field and effects may support presentation but may not hide identity-critical errors, invent aura/emission, erase mobility equipment or replace identity palette.
Surface rendering and tone mapping must preserve skin/body identity, age, body volume and material-class differences without universal gloss, beauty smoothing, humanization or invented microtexture.

Contrast and value hierarchy must preserve skin/body identity, body category, mobility equipment and identity midtones without invented outlines/glow, automatic premium contrast or night-time crushing.

Edges describe authorized shape rather than redesigning it; line cleanup, anti-aliasing and small-scale simplification may not enlarge eyes, beautify jaws, slim bodies, erase mobility equipment, invent exposure or add white/neon readability outlines.

Information density is not rarity, importance, beauty or professionalism; every visible detail needs an authorized identity, construction, use, storage, repair, material, era/world or source-history job, and unsupported ornament defaults to zero/minimum sufficient detail.

Negative space is identity-critical readability structure; effects, ornament, premium polish, action posing and high resolution may not fill functional gaps, detach props, hide mobility equipment, force relationship touching silhouettes or turn generated spacing accidents into canon.

LOD is information reduction rather than character redesign; portrait, sprite, chibi, resolution or distance changes may not enlarge eyes, beautify jaw/chin, alter head/body or limb proportions, slim bodies, de-age, shrink mobility equipment, mascotify animals or humanize robots.

Every visual state is baseline plus explicitly authorized delta; unspecified axes inherit baseline, and Dawn/Kokuyou/premium/battle/seasonal labels do not permit automatic body, exposure, modification, disability, garment, prop, palette, maintenance, ornament or relationship redesign.
